title: Where You Go, I Will Go
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Naomi's husband passed away,
And both her sons died too.
She told young Ruth, "Go home, my dear,"
Ruth said, "I'll stay with you."

[Chorus]
Where you go, I will go, my friend,
No matter near or far.
For love that stays is strong and true,
I'll stay right where you are.

[Verse 2]
"Your God will be my God," she said,
"Where you go, I will go."
To Bethlehem they walked as one,
Ruth loved Naomi so.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
And rest your sleepy head.
The Lord stays close to you all night,
Right here beside your bed.

[Chorus]
mood: Cradle music. A slow, steady rock in three, like two travelers walking side by side on a long road, holds under the voice from the first line. The sway never rushes and never wavers, the way Ruth's love never wavered when leaving would have been easier. By the last verse the rocking grows lower and slower, until it feels like a hand resting still on a blanket.
